recipes.title: Smoked Mackerel Avocado Mash
recipes.ingredients: 1 Smoked Mackerel fillet, 1 ripe Avocado, 1 tbsp Lemon juice, Black pepper, fresh Dill.
recipes.instructions: 1. Flake the mackerel into a bowl. 2. Add avocado and mash with a fork. 3. Stir in lemon juice and pepper. 4. Serve on keto bread or cucumber slices.

recipes.title: Chocolate Brownies (Erythritol)
recipes.ingredients: 200g Dark Chocolate (85%), 100g Butter, 3 Eggs, 150g Erythritol, 50g Almond Flour, 20g Cocoa Powder.
recipes.instructions: 1. Melt chocolate and butter together. 2. Whisk eggs and erythritol until fluffy. 3. Fold in chocolate mix, then dry ingredients. 4. Bake at 180°C for 20 mins.
